cells.title: Render the workspace protocol from the project at init
cells.action: In verbs/protocol.rs replace the fixed TEMPLATE render with a render from the control root per CONTEXT D1-D6 (keep a pure fn `render_protocol(facts) -> String` and a fn that gathers the facts from the root, so tests feed fake facts and temp git repos). Read git through the crate's existing git helpers where one exists (no new dependency); strip `user[:pass]@` from the origin URL. Read `uat_stop` through the existing config reader. The rendered file must check `valid` with protocol_state, hold no placeholder and no FULL_TEST or other test command. Output: text mode prints `wrote <path>`, then one next line naming the review files and the judgment work (D6); `--json` carries `ok, path, facts:[{key,value,source}], review:[paths]`. D7: add `--print` (text: the rendered file on stdout; json: `rendered` plus facts and review); it writes nothing and works when a file exists; without it an existing file still returns the protocol_exists refusal unchanged. Declare `--print` and the new output in registry_payload.json under protocol.init. If the flag name `print` is new to the catalog, raise PINNED_FLAG_COUNT in catalog.rs by exactly the new names, citing c5e4d24a. Tests: a temp git repo with origin `https://u:p@example.com/o/r.git` and origin/HEAD renders REPOSITORY_REMOTE without `u:p@` and DEFAULT_BRANCH from origin/HEAD; no origin leaves both keys out (branch falls back to the current branch); uat_stop merge vs absent gives the two MERGE_OWNER texts; scripts/release.sh present gives the DEPLOY_OWNER line naming it, a `.github/workflows/release.yml` alone names that, none gives `human`; a present `.claude/skills` dir adds its PROTECTED_AREAS item, an absent one does not; the render checks valid and has a Sources line per derived key; `review` lists only existing files; --print on an existing file returns the render and leaves the file bytes unchanged; init on an existing file still refuses. No code comments.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee protocol && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee catalog && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts

truths: init writes git facts, MERGE_OWNER from uat_stop and DEPLOY_OWNER from the first release entry
the origin URL never carries credentials
the rendered file checks valid and holds no test command
a Sources list and the json facts name where each derived key came from
init names the review files that exist
--print writes nothing and works on an existing file; plain init still refuses an existing file
prohibitions: No overwrite path for an existing file

cells.title: Document the agent step that finishes a project's protocol
cells.action: Per D8, add section "Workspace protocol" to skills/bee-hive/references/onboarding.md in its existing style (ASD-STE100, short sentences): when (the owner asks, or bee protocol check is not valid); steps: run `bee protocol init --json` (or `--print` when a file exists); read every `review` path; add the project's own boundaries, protected areas and anti-patterns and set PROJECT_CRITICALITY, each added line cited in `## Sources`; no placeholder, no test command; run `bee protocol check` until valid; commit; show the owner a table of key, value and source. Point at the repo-root WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL.md of the bee repo as the reference result. In skills/bee-hive/SKILL.md Onboarding add exactly one pointer line to that section. In the workspace-protocol concept, record that init renders from the project (D1-D7), cite decision c5e4d24a, and note it narrows the fixed template of workspace-protocol D4. Then run the full regen chain `bee dev regen` (render-skill-trees, onboard --repo-root . --apply, release-manifest --write) once from the worktree and commit the regenerated files with this cell. No code comments.
cells.verify: .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check && rg -n 'Workspace protocol' skills/bee-hive/references/onboarding.md && rg -n 'c5e4d24a' docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/workspace-protocol.md

truths: the onboarding reference holds the agent procedure with the review-files step
bee-hive SKILL.md points at it in one line
the concept records the project render and cites c5e4d24a
key_links: SKILL.md Onboarding points at the section

stages.reason: Tests ride the code cell; the live proof is the leader's.
pi-2 writes the agent procedure and the concept.
A release is a separate user ask.
Every job has a specific role.
